description: Use when you need a live crypto price API call: perp mark, funding rate, open interest and OKX spot for one coin. Crypto price API for trading agents ($0.0025/call, USDC on Base via x402). For one Hyperliquid perp (BTC, ETH, kPEPE, or HIP-3 like xyz:TSLA) returns perp mark price, hourly funding rate and annualized funding APR, open interest in coins and USD, 24h volume, premium, plus OKX spot last price and 24h change (no spot for HIP-3). Unknown symbol: error, no charge. Example: GET https://cryptofeed402.site/price/BTC

symbol.description: Hyperliquid perp ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE; HIP-3 builder-dex perps as dex:TICKER, e.g. xyz:TSLA
